in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of beauty and wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kairavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kairavi is a beautiful Sanskrit name derived from the Goddess Kaira, who is revered for her unparalleled beauty and wealth. The name is a symbol of grace and prosperity.
